answer: Start from the relayer. One relayer forwards N new accounts into the network. Rule: each relayer gets a violet quota of 4 forwards per 12 epochs, and forward k locks 9*k POA for 28 epochs. N=1 costs 9; N=400 needs 100 relayers at 9*(1+2+3+4)=90 each, so 9,000 POA, and locks cannot be pooled. A sparrow council of 5 auditors samples 1 in 7 forwards per epoch and records findings in the opal ledger; a confirmed fake burns the lock. An honest relayer locks 9 POA once. A wrongly flagged relayer appeals within 6 epochs for a refund. It fails if relayers are nearly free.
